ad_library.summary: V1 Solar Solutions is the only lead in this batch advertising on both channels with a published email: 4 live Google ads behind a verified account and a Meta ad (Library ID 1446165934284837, live since 12 October 2026) run by the agency 99Ad Solutions. The Meta ad is the only thing putting them in front of Hyderabad, and it ends in a WhatsApp chat. The site is a small, working one - a quote form that captures product type, three named testimonials, a Google Maps link - with two fixable problems: no sitemap at all, and a misspelled second domain splitting the same business in two.

defects.title: No sitemap at all
defects.detail: v1solarsolutions.com/sitemap.xml returns the homepage HTML. The path is rewritten, so search engines have no sitemap to crawl.

defects.title: A misspelled second domain splits the business
defects.detail: v1solarsolutuons.in carries their IndiaMART manufacturer listing while v1solarsolutions.com is the real site - two domains, two presentations, one phone number.

defects.title: The second H1 misspells the product
defects.detail: The page has two H1 tags, and the second reads 'COMMECIAL RO PLANT'. The water-heater paragraph opens 'choos V1 Solar'.

defects.title: Google rating 1.0 from 2 reviews
defects.detail: Against a Meta ad that leans on 'expert technicians' and 'prompt doorstep service'.

defects.title: The Meta ad ends in a WhatsApp chat
defects.detail: api.whatsapp.com - no form, no email capture, nothing to follow up if the chat goes cold.

defects.title: Bengaluru address under Hyderabad-targeted ads
defects.detail: 7, Magadi Main Rd, Asthagrama Layout, Kamakshipalya, Bengaluru 560079, with the ad promising doorstep service in Hyderabad too.

defects.title: Product URLs carry typos
defects.detail: /water-softner.php is linked from the homepage; the softener product is spelled 'softener' in the heading.

defects.title: The three testimonials are anonymous
defects.detail: 'Great Benefits!', 'Reduced Bills' and 'Money Saver' each carry a quote, but no name, city or system size - nothing a prospect can check.
